contract.postcondition: let entries:Set(OrderEntry) = self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries@pre in self.CurrentOrderProduct.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::REQUESTED and result = true and if entries->isEmpty() then self.CurrentOrderProduct.Amount = self.CurrentOrderProduct.Amount@pre else self.CurrentOrderProduct.Amount = self.CurrentOrderProduct.Amount@pre + entries->sumBy(e:OrderEntry | e.SubAmount@pre) endif
